title: Limit system access to authorized users
summary: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices.

title: Limit system access to authorized functions
summary: Limit system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

title: Employ least privilege
summary: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts.

title: Monitor and control remote access sessions
summary: Monitor and control remote access sessions.

title: Security awareness training
summary: Ensure managers, systems administrators, and users are made aware of security risks and applicable policies.

title: Create and retain system audit logs
summary: Create and retain system audit logs and records to enable monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized activity.

title: Establish baseline configurations
summary: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems throughout the lifecycle.

title: Identify users and processes
summary: Identify system users, processes acting on behalf of users, and devices.

title: Multifactor authentication
summary: Use multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.

title: Establish incident-handling capability
summary: Establish an operational incident-handling capability including preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities.

title: Perform system maintenance
summary: Perform maintenance on organizational systems.

title: Protect system media
summary: Protect (i.e., physically control and securely store) system media containing CUI, both paper and digital.

title: Screen individuals
summary: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to organizational systems containing CUI.

title: Limit physical access
summary: Limit physical access to organizational systems, equipment, and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals.

title: Assess risk periodically
summary: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations, assets, and individuals resulting from operation of organizational systems and processing of CUI.

title: Periodically assess security controls
summary: Periodically assess the security controls in organizational systems to determine if the controls are effective.

title: Monitor and control communications
summary: Monitor, control, and protect communications at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of organizational systems.

title: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography
summary: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI.

title: Identify and correct flaws
summary: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner.

title: Provide malicious code protection
summary: Provide protection from malicious code at designated locations within organizational systems.
